concepts.def: Protecting species, habitats and ecosystems from harm and restoring those already damaged.
Protected area established to conserve wildlife and landscape; UK has 15.
Breeding endangered species in zoos to boost numbers and reintroduce to the wild.
Restoring ecosystems by reintroducing keystone species (e.g., wolves to Yellowstone, beavers to UK).
Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (1973) regulating wildlife trade.
Species whose role disproportionately affects the ecosystem (e.g., sea otters, wolves).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Conservation — a core area of GCSE Environmental Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Conservation brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Conservation.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which body regulates wildlife trade internationally?
options: IUCN
CITES
WWF
UNEP

mcqs.q: Reintroducing wolves to Yellowstone is an example of?
options: Captive breeding
Rewilding
Bioremediation
Selective breeding
The maximum population an environment can sustainably support given available resources.
How much an animal can physically carry.
It removes carbon permanently.
The size a species can reach.

mcqs.q: Why are top predators most affected by persistent pollutants like mercury?
options: Biomagnification concentrates pollutants at each trophic level up the food chain.
The size a species can reach.
Predators have weaker immune systems.
Predators are exposed to more pollution directly.

mcqs.q: Why is burning fossil fuels considered to disrupt the carbon cycle?
options: It releases carbon stored for millions of years much faster than the cycle can absorb.
Predators have weaker immune systems.
It creates new carbon that did not exist before.
It removes carbon permanently.
